text:
3 hours ago In this latest installment of CrimeStoppers Honolulu, Sgt. Ed Ho shares three of the latest cases involving fradulent use of a credit card in a convenience store, burglary from a residential garage (video is very clear) and a robbery suspect with a fidgety habit of biting his nails. Do you recognize any of these suspects? Your tips leading to arrest or conviction can earn you up to $1,000. Use the P3Tips app, call (808) 955-8300 or go to www.honolulucrimestoppers.org.
